rss: Overcooked? Why robotic pizza makers are failing
title: Robots Struggle to Make Perfect Pizzas
story: PZZA wanted to use robots to make their pizzas faster. But the robots made pizzas that were too crispy or not cooked enough!
storyBig: PZZA's attempt to automate pizza production with robots has encountered significant setbacks, as the machines fail to achieve consistent quality. This has led to a loss of confidence in their ability to replace human chefs entirely.
think: Why do you think robots sometimes have trouble doing human jobs?
bull: Robots might still learn to make better pizzas in the future.
bear: Using robots could lead to less tasty pizzas for now.

rss: I was spending £700 a month: How I beat my late-night shopping addiction
title: Late-Night Shopping: A Tricky Habit
story: Many people like to shop late at night, but it can be hard to stop! Learning to control spending is important for saving money.
storyBig: Impulse shopping, especially during late-night hours, has become a growing trend, leading to increased consumer debt. By adopting mindful spending habits, individuals can better manage their finances and avoid unnecessary expenses.
think: What are some ways you can save your money instead of spending it?
bull: Learning to save means you can buy something you really want later.
bear: Spending too much now means less money for important things.
